guidanceReview.rationale: Adds get_structure guidance for sparse native 3D readback, retaining configured disabled states and distinguishing omitted defaults or unavailable fields from verified clears. Published 1.0.3 already transports these native fields; older epoch-1 tool guidance remains valid and does not promise default 3D values. Argument and result wire contracts, control and extension protocols, and durable state remain compatible with 1.0.3 and earlier epoch-1 releases. The site-only Node 26 TypeScript configuration update changes no shipped runtime dependencies or guidance. Non-major dependency updates include ws 8.23.0's bounded automatic Pong buffering; tool behavior, shipped guidance, protocols, and durable state remain compatible.
